evidence.excerpt: Grbić collaborated with a regional flexible-packaging converter (FlexoPak d.o.o.) over three years on production-scale validation of seal-layer formulations developed in the laboratory, including line trials on a commercial VFFS machine. He has provided informal technical consulting to two other packaging companies in Vojvodina on heat-seal troubleshooting.
